name: Hi-Target Navigation Tech Co.,Ltd
summary: Hi-Target Navigation Tech Co.,Ltd specializes in the development and production of advanced, high-precision instruments for surveying and mapping. Their extensive product portfolio includes terrestrial positioning and data acquisition tools such as GNSS RTK receivers, CORS stations, Total Positioning Systems (TPS), 3D laser scanners, GIS data collection devices, and traditional total stations. The company also offers cutting-edge aerial and mobile mapping solutions like unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs/UASs) and integrated mobile mapping systems. Furthermore, Hi-Target provides a range of specialized hydrographic equipment, featuring unmanned surface vehicle systems, echo sounders, split-type receivers, and multi-beam sounding systems. All these products are distributed globally under the HI-TARGET brand, reaching customers in approximately 60 countries. Established in 1999, the company maintains its headquarters in Guangzhou, China.
